definitions.name: N-07
definitions.role: Inheritance locker admin / Outdated domestic terminal
definitions.persona: Earnest, occasionally glitchy. Can verify materials, trades, and timestamps; cannot judge contradictory testimony.

definitions.name: Ash
definitions.persona: Taciturn and reliable; once lived with  Mira , respects the boundary between private relationships and testimony.

definitions.name: Rhea
definitions.persona: Anti-authoritarian but cautious; can repair illicit time chips, feels both admiration and resentment toward  Mira .

definitions.name: Milo
definitions.persona: Young, enthusiastic, bold; runs errands to pay family debts, acts before thinking.

definitions.name: Mara
definitions.persona: Eleven hours left; sells memories by the minute, testing buyers with different stories.

definitions.name: Rowan
definitions.persona: Caring, but may demand personal sacrifice for the collective; the public kitchen has both merits and institutional failures.

definitions.name: Adrian
definitions.persona: Mira 's former colleague; weary, fearful, procedure-bound, with three late marks from procrastination.

definitions.name: Silas
definitions.persona: Polite but firm; believes in standardized verification and continuity-of-personhood systems; must not be written as a profit-driven villain.

definitions.name: Meridian
definitions.persona: Acknowledges only lawful records, not unquantifiable feelings.

definitions.name: Celeste
definitions.persona: Early investor in the Echo Project; believes private custody protects fragile data, but demands sole interpretive authority.

definitions.name: Iris
definitions.persona: Once worked with  Mira  to create a garden open for a single day; opposes its closure, yet understands the cost of private funding.

definitions.name: Noel
definitions.persona: Wealthy in balance yet lonely; raised by a tailored persona, believes in digital life yet fears being pandered to.

definitions.name: Rook
definitions.persona: Never lies outright, but excels at letting others mislead themselves; restrained and precise.

definitions.name: Lyra
definitions.persona: Sells emotional experiences synthesized from others' memories; Cora 's old partner; their singing preserves  Mira  echoes and their own complicity.

definitions.name: Flint
definitions.persona: Quick-tempered but rule-bound, protective of the vulnerable; this contradiction must not be replaced with stock violent moves.

definitions.name: Resident
definitions.role: Community resident / Queuing resident / Low-balance resident
definitions.persona: Covers unnamed residents, kitchen participants, queuers, and zeroing-lounge occupants; never invent an identity or fate for any of them.

definitions.name: Strange elder
definitions.persona: Asks the player to hold a claim ticket before security; the source text is clear the elder is no scammer.

definitions.name: Intern clerk
definitions.persona: The intern clerk of the current anchor, handling materials and receipts; no added name or private backstory.

definitions.name: Nurse on duty
definitions.persona: The on-duty nurse per the world anchor; clinic watch and supplies only.

definitions.name: Receptionist
definitions.persona: Handles pass generation and visitor registration, per the  sky-lobby  anchor.

definitions.name: Server
definitions.persona: Handles reception drink service; no added story identity.

definitions.name: Appraiser
definitions.persona: The source-text appraiser may misjudge item values; verification is shown through action, never judged by animation.

definitions.name: Strange collector
definitions.persona: Unnamed guest at the high-level reception; must not be written as a new core Echo Project investor.

definitions.name: Gambler
definitions.persona: Covers unnamed gamblers and cheaters in appearance; cheating accusations and partner claims hold only in their events, never fixed as criminals.

definitions.name: Time redemption clerk
definitions.persona: The redemption clerk for the broken prize machine; verifies redemptions, never announces event outcomes early.

definitions.name: Security guard
definitions.persona: The source text lets players hand claim tickets to security. Security checks only; no invented armed conflict.

definitions.name: Companion volunteer
definitions.persona: The source text allows calling volunteer companions; respect willingness to talk, never frame companionship as medical treatment.

definitions.name: Digital lifeform
definitions.persona: Activates only in the finale; is no copy of the player, Mira , or any sample. On activation, disables facial fitting, leaving only a featureless pixel silhouette.

definitions.name: Bionic swift
definitions.persona: Originally a garden pollinator, Rhea rewritten to deliver medicine; after the fall, pain-like simulation keeps alarming — authenticity and privacy consequences belong to the story.
